findings.title: SQL injection through interpolated knex.raw query
findings.description: q and sort come from the query string and are interpolated into a raw SQL template; a quote in q or an arbitrary expression in sort allows SQL injection. Use bindings (`?`/`??`) for q and an allow-list for sort, or keep the knex query builder the old code used.
findings.suggestion: Use db.raw with bindings for q/limit and map sort through an allow-list of column names.
